name: Junqueirópolis (Brazil)
description: Celestial blue field charged at the centre with a white equilateral triangle bearing the municipal arms.
history: Junqueirópolis is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag was prescribed by Law No. 1,010 of 30 May 1978: celestial blue for the rivers and the sky, white for peace; the arms in their present form date from Law No. 2,108 of 21 May 2002.
